source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 505 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 505 was established by Ordinance No. 23501, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 22, 1998. Ordinance No. 23501 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 505 is established on property generally located along the east line of Dowdy Ferry Road, south of the south line of Rylie Road. The size of PD 505 is approximately 19.95 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 505A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Private recreation center, club, or area.

(b) Restaurant without drive-in or drive-through service. [This use is only permitted when operated in conjunction with a private recreation center, club, or area.]

(c) Community service center.

(d) Commercial amusement (inside).

(e) Commercial amusement (outside).

(f) Commercial wedding chapel.

(g) Hotel or motel. [This use is limited to a maximum of 10 guest rooms. The guest rooms may be housed separately in individual structures.]

(h) Except as provided above, the uses permitted in this district are all uses allowed in an A(A) Agricultural District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the A(A) Agricultural District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the A(A) Agricultural District by specific use permit (SUP) is only permitted in this PD by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the A(A) Agricultural District is subject to DIR in this PD. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.106. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front, side, and rear yard. Front, side, and rear yard setbacks are as shown on the development plan.

(b) Floor area ratio. Maximum permitted floor area ratio is 0.05.

(c) Floor area. Maximum floor area for all structures combined is 43,560 square feet.

(d) Height.

(1) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope originating in an R, R(A), D, D(A), THE, or THE(A) district. (See Section 51A-4.412.) Exception: Except for chimneys, structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less. Chimneys may project through the slope to a height 12 feet above the maximum structure height.

(2) Maximum height. Unless further restricted above, maximum structure height is 26 feet.

(e) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 25 percent.

(f) Lot size.

(1) No minimum lot size for nonresidential uses.

(2) Minimum lot size for a residential use is three acres.

(g) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.107. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Required off-street parking must be provided at a ratio of one space per 100 square feet of floor area and located as shown on the development plan. Sixty off-street parking spaces, the maneuvering area for the 60 parking spaces, and all required fire lanes must be on a compacted sub-grade, and must consist of one of the following: (1) concrete paving; (2) hot mix asphalt paving which consists of a binder and surface course; or, (3) a material which has equivalent characteristics of (1) or (2) above and approved by

the building official. The remaining off-street parking and maneuvering areas must consist of an all- weather and drainable material which is approved by the building official. For all permitted uses, off- street loading must be provided in accordance with the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.108. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.109. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided and completed in accordance with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.110. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. The restaurant without drive-in or drive-through service use and the hotel or motel use may have no exterior advertising signs on the same lot. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.111. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.112. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.113. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.114. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-505.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 505 is located on Zoning Map No. N-10. (Ord. Nos. 23501; 26042)
